description: Trend stats for one research topic across NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML and CVPR, 2023–2026: paper counts by year × venue, year-over-year growth, fastest-growing co-labeled sub-themes, sibling topics in the same area, and ~20 representative papers (title, venue, year, paperlist id). Precomputed snapshot, no live aggregation. Get slugs from list_topics (e.g. world-models, multimodal-llms, reinforcement-learning). For ICLR 2027 primary areas, pass a slug from list_conferences topics_for {conference:"iclr", year:2027} (prefixed iclr2027-).
name: get_topic_stats
title: Get topic stats
